Name: Replacement Portrait for Gale Dekarios - Wizard of Waterdeep
Author: paperpout
Description:
This mod is a portrait replacement for Gale Dekarios in the Wizard of Waterdeep mod. 
This is just a new portrait for Gale, the mod to add him to the game can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21855]here[/url]﻿

I just made this for myself but I thought I should share it in case other people want to use it. 


[b]Requirements 

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Valley Modding API
[/url]﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21855]Wizard of Waterdeep - Gale Dekarios from Baldur's Gate 3
[/url]﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description]Portraiture
[/url][/b]

[b]How to Install 

[/b]- Install all the required mods 
- Follow the installation instructions for the Portraiture mod until you have the file path  "Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits"
- Unzip this file and drop it into the Portraits folder 
- Open the game using SMAPI 
- Press P during dialogue with Gale to change his portrait 


[b]Recommended[/b]

I used the portrait mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23491]Granny Eun's Vanilla Portraits [/url] so I drew these Gale Dekarios portraits to work with them in a similar style

[b]Ps.
[/b]
I will make Astarion's, Karlach's and Gortash's Portraits ASAP and any other Baldur's Gate Characters that people make mods for :)
